title: contacts-server: destroyFromIfInState mismatch uses per-id notDestroyed instead of method error
description: crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/card.rs (~585-604) reports a destroyFromIfInState mismatch on ContactCard/copy as a stateMismatch entry per source id in the implicit ContactCard/set notDestroyed map. RFC 8620 §5.4 passes destroyFromIfInState on as ifInState to the implicit Foo/set, and §5.3 says on ifInState mismatch 'the method will be aborted and a "stateMismatch" error returned'; stateMismatch is not a §5.3 SetError type. Align with tasks/mail/calendars/filenode (JMAP-2svx): emit ("error", {"type":"stateMismatch"}) in place of the implicit set response. Found during JMAP-2svx.
